package.name: aav_io_mux
package.description: The muxes at the two edges of the stack. sensor_mux checks that every sensor comes from the one source a run asks for (source:=real, sim, bench or replay) and says so on /system/sensor_mux/state; output_mux passes ego's /ego/actuator_cmd on to one target's /control/target/actuator_cmd (target:=car, gazebo, bench, turtle or carla), and to the real car only while every source is REAL, else a latched stop. So simulated data can never drive the real car.
